changelog: **One permission layer for admins (#1569, story #1565).** `src/lib/authzRule.ts` (pure, unit-tested in `scripts/test/authz-rule.test.mjs`) holds the permission catalogue (`platform.*`, `org.*`, `user.*`, `program.*`, `relation.write`, `pipeline.transition`, `audit.*`, `activity.read`, `company.*`), the tier table (ORG_ADMIN ⊃ PROGRAM_ADMIN ⊃ OBSERVER; OBSERVER is built from the `.read` names only; no tier holds `platform.*`) and `decide()`, which fails closed: unknown permission, no tier, cross-org subject (super admin included — `platform.*` is the only platform power), a PROGRAM_ADMIN without a covering `AdminScopeGrant`, an OBSERVER write and any non-read under impersonation are refused with a reason. `src/lib/authz.ts` (server-only) adds `can()`, `actorFromSession()` (the live user row — a narrowed admin bites on the next request) and the guard `requirePermission(permission, { subject, request })` → 401 / `403 permission_denied` + one `authz.capability_denied` ActivityLog row naming actor, permission, route and reason. Named apart from the per-vertical `requireCapability()` on purpose. `adminLevel` is carried on the session (sign-in, impersonation revert, `session.update()`) for the UI. No route uses it yet — #1583 is the first consumer, #1571 the migration.
